ReCiPe 2016 Endpoint (H). A avaliação de impacto utiliza fatores de caracterização (CFs) regionalizados que convertem emissões de precursores de material particulado (como NH3, NOx, SO2) e emissões diretas de PM2.5 em um impacto na saúde humana (DALY). Os CFs globais representam uma média mundial, enquanto os CFs para o Brasil refletem a densidade populacional e as condições atmosféricas médias do país.
IMPACT World+. The model provides characterization factors (CFs) at a global average level and at a country-specific level. State-level factors are not directly provided by the model.

ReCiPe 2016 v1.1 Endpoint (H/A). The model provides characterization factors (CFs) for fine particulate matter formation, expressed in DALYs per kg of emitted precursor. Global CFs represent a world average. Brazil CFs are specific to emissions occurring within Brazil's national territory.

ReCiPe 2016 v1.1, Hierarchist (H) perspective. Global factors are the default 'World' average for rural/low population density emissions. Brazil-specific factors are representative values from regionalized models (e.g., LC-IMPACT) that account for national-average conditions.
